The '''Troukree''' were a reptilian [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]], native to their [[Troukree homeworld|homeworld]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. Some of them served [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] in his fight against [[Nuso Esva]] on [[Poln Major]], using their prowess with [[Troukree knife|blades]] in close-quarters combat. They had a strong belief in an honor system. Several Troukree fought alongside renegade [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Daric LaRone]] and his [[Hand of Judgment]] as well.
